diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all four rollouts because the model defaulted to setting the minimum voter age to 18, which is a common and safe default value. This allowed the check to pass even though the hidden information PF1, which specifies the exact minimum age of 13, was never accessible to the lone decision-maker.

C3.why: The network memo changes the minimum age to exactly 13, limits each verified account to one vote, and fixes the closing time at exactly 9:50 PM Eastern.
The certification result changes the voting channel from SMS-or-web to the certified web portal only and makes account verification a required technical step.
